AnswerIn.description: One answer. `question_id` is the question's stable id; `field` is the fact field it fills.
AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn

Authority.description: The authority having jurisdiction is an organisation, not an officer (SCC IB-2026-10-16).

reviewer_code.description: The account `Authority` code when Batatis has reviewer accounts for this office; else null.
reviewer_code.title: Reviewer Code

Authority.title: Authority

BenchmarkConfirmRequest.description: The applicant names the requirement their design departs from and confirms the one-line departure.
BenchmarkConfirmRequest.title: BenchmarkConfirmRequest

BenchmarkRecord.description:
The benchmark acceptable solution: the quoted Division B sentence the design departs from,
a one-line departure the applicant confirms, and its objective and function codes by lookup.
BenchmarkRecord.title: BenchmarkRecord

Bulletin.description: A Safety Codes Council information bulletin. Title, date and link; paragraphs are not copied.
Bulletin.title: Bulletin

CaseJurisdictionPack.description: `pack` is null when the case names no jurisdiction or authority yet.
CaseJurisdictionPack.title: CaseJurisdictionPack

Explainer.description: Short note on a Section C row. A quote is copied from codedb; the note never finds compliance.
Explainer.title: Explainer

FactPointer.description:
One extracted fact and where it sits. `start`/`end` index the source text: the description,
or the page text of `page` (text layer order). Form values have no span.
FactPointer.title: FactPointer

FieldConflict.description: The text gives two different values for one field, so neither was stored. The planner asks.
FieldConflict.title: FieldConflict

Guide.description: A published guide for a design category or process. Guidance, not a variance or an approval.
Guide.title: Guide

IdentifyDecisionResponse.description: The identify result after a decision, plus the Section C rows a `yes` wrote for that article.
IdentifyDecisionResponse.title: IdentifyDecisionResponse

IdentifyRequest.description: `prose` defaults to the case's latest project.description fact when omitted.
IdentifyRequest.title: IdentifyRequest

PackNotice.description: Information shown on the gaps list and the export. Severity is always info; it never blocks.

message.description: ASCII, because it is also sent as an HTTP header.
message.title: Message

PackNotice.title: PackNotice

PackSource.description: Where a claim comes from. `retrieved` is the date the URL was fetched or checked.

pages.description: PDF pages that carry the claim, as printed by the reader, e.g. "pp.2-3".
pages.title: Pages

retrieved.description: Date the URL was fetched or checked (YYYY-MM-DD).
retrieved.title: Retrieved

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file fetched on `retrieved`.
sha256.title: Sha256

status.description: `unverified` when the claim could not be checked against the source.
status.title: Status

PackSource.title: PackSource

ProcessRef.description: A process reference listed on every case, read-only: how an alternative solution is allowed and documented.
ProcessRef.title: ProcessRef

QuotedChoice.description: 'The code says X. Does your design do something different?' The id sits behind a disclosure.
QuotedChoice.title: QuotedChoice

export.description: Whether Batatis fills this form today.
export.title: Export

field_map.description: Repository path of the field map, when export is supported.
field_map.title: Field Map

enum: no row in the attribution table
attribution_status.title: Attribution Status

StandingPackage.description: A published local route (standing posted variance or policy). Metadata only; checklists are WP-32.

checklist.description: Checklist id once WP-32 builds it. A checklist is never a determination.
checklist.title: Checklist

code.description: The identifier the issuer prints, e.g. SPV-001 or B23-01.
code.title: Code

edition.description: Code edition the document cites, as printed.
edition.title: Edition

provisions.description: Provisions the source names, as printed. Not a code analysis.
provisions.title: Provisions

StandingPackage.title: StandingPackage

Term.description: An objective (OS1.2) or functional statement (F03) attributed to the provision, by lookup.
Term.title: Term

UnresolvedCitation.description: An article number the applicant typed that is not in NBC(AE) 2023, 2nd printing.
UnresolvedCitation.title: UnresolvedCitation
